name: timetracker-context
description: Feeds rich editor context (repo, branch, file, symbol, terminal commands, task) to the local TimeTracker app for better ticket inference. 100% local — no network calls. Over Remote-SSH/Codespaces/WSL, pair with 'TimeTracker Context Bridge' (installed locally) so the heartbeat still reaches your machine.

timetracker.captureTerminalCommands.markdownDescription: Capture recent integrated-terminal commands (e.g. `terraform`, `kubectl`) into the heartbeat TimeTracker reads for ticket attribution. **Off by default**: a command line can contain secrets typed inline — tokens in `export FOO=...`, passwords in connection strings, `curl -H "Authorization: Bearer ..."`. Turning this on sends that text into TimeTracker's local heartbeat file (and, over Remote-SSH, through the Bridge extension to your local machine) — still never over the network, but worth the tradeoff being explicit rather than default-on.
